name: @st-gr/sail-proxy
description: SAP AI Core Local LLM Proxy - A command-line tool to run a local proxy for SAP AI Core Foundation Models
author: st-gr

scripts.build: npm run sync-version && npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run copy-templates && npm run bundle
scripts.build:local: npm run clean:dist && npm run compile && npm run copy-templates
scripts.copy-templates: npx mkdirp dist/templates && npx copyfiles -u 1 "src/templates/**/*" dist/
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:dependencies && npm run bundle:gateway && npm run bundle:ollama && npm run bundle:install-prod-deps && npm run bundle:gateway-aliases
scripts.bundle:gateway: cd ../../services/gateway && pnpm build && npx mkdirp ../../npm-dist/sail-proxy/bundled/gateway && npx copyfiles -u 1 "dist/**/*" ../../npm-dist/sail-proxy/bundled/gateway/ && node ../../npm-dist/sail-proxy/scripts/create-production-package-json.js ../../services/gateway/package.json ../../npm-dist/sail-proxy/bundled/gateway/package.json
scripts.bundle:install-prod-deps: cd bundled/gateway && npm install --production && cd ../ollama && npm install --production
scripts.bundle:ollama: npx mkdirp bundled/ollama && npx copyfiles -u 2 "../../services/ollama/*.js" bundled/ollama/ && node ../../npm-dist/sail-proxy/scripts/create-production-package-json.js ../../services/ollama/package.json ../../npm-dist/sail-proxy/bundled/ollama/package.json && npx copyfiles -u 2 "../../services/ollama/routes/**/*" "../../services/ollama/services/**/*" "../../services/ollama/controllers/**/*" bundled/ollama/
scripts.link:dev: npm run build:local && npm run bundle:dependencies && npm link
